title: Harmonium Tak Rosak
genre: Malay qawwali-style devotional-romantic song (harmonium, tabla and handclap call-and-response)
subject: A harmonium repairer in Brickfields who finds nothing wrong with the old family harmonium the same girl brings in every month, and finally stops pretending to search for the fault.
caption: Malay qawwali-style song with a rolling eight-beat tabla groove. Harmonium playing a rising chordal melody with reed vibrato, tabla and dholak driving a steady cycle, rhythmic handclaps on the backbeat, sarangi doubling the vocal line. Live room recording, handclaps close, warm reed tone. Male lead vocal with a small group answering each line, strong mid register, clearly sung. 100 BPM, D major. Warm, rising, openly in love. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. No synth, no drum machine, no autotune, no rap, no electric guitar, no EDM.
lyrics:
[Intro - harmonium and tabla, handclaps enter]

[Verse 1]
Setiap bulan dia bawa harmonium
Katanya kekunci ketiga tersangkut
Kubuka, kubersih, kutekan semua
Tiada apa-apa yang rosak di situ

[Pre-Chorus]
Dia senyum, dia pura-pura hairan
Aku pun pura-pura mencari

[Chorus]
Tekan sekali lagi, katanya
Bunyinya tak betul, katanya
Harmonium tak rosak, sayang
Yang rosak hatiku di kedai ini

[Verse 2]
Ayahnya beli di Jalan Tun Sambanthan
Dua puluh tahun bunyinya masih bulat
Bulan depan dia datang lagi
Aku sudah sediakan teh dua cawan

[Pre-Chorus]
Hari ini kuletak alat di tepi
Kuberanikan diri, kupandang dia

[Chorus]
Tekan sekali lagi, kataku
Bunyinya betul, kataku
Harmonium tak rosak, sayang
Marilah main lagu dengan aku

[Outro - harmonium and tabla, handclaps slow to a stop]
Tekan sekali lagi, sayang
Harmonium tak rosak
